paragraphs.en: Taking {responsibility} for mistakes is a {positive} step, but don't {beat} yourself up about them or leave yourself at the {bottom} of an emotional well.To {err} is human.Mistakes aren't {bombs} that {explode} in your life to ruin everythingIt's just as {important} to show yourself some {forgiveness} .You can use the following writing {exercise} to help you {bounce} back and soar ( (高飞) ) once again.
paragraphs.cn: 对错误负 <u> 责 </u> 是 <u> 积极的 </u> 一步，但不要为此 <u> 过分自责 </u> ，也不要让自己陷入情绪的谷 <u> 底 </u> 。 <u> 犯错 </u> 是人之常情。错误不是在生活中 <u> 爆炸 </u> 并毁掉一切的 <u> 炸弹 </u> 。 <u> 宽恕 </u> 自己同样 <u> 重要 </u> 。你可以通过以下的写作 <u> 练习 </u> 来帮助自己重新 <u> 振作 </u> ，再次展翅高飞。

paragraphs.en: In a journal or on a {sheet} of paper, put the {title} " {Personal} strengths."Imagine you're a {candidate} applying for your dream job.You would highlight your skills and achievements to impress the {boss} .Now list all the {characteristics} you like about yourself.Are you {caring} ? {Creative} ? {Generous} ? A good {listener} ? Give them a {nod} of approval.They don't have to be world-changing, or as great as mastering {calligraphy} , speaking {French} , or playing the {jazz} guitar, just {aspects} of your {personality} that you're {proud} of.
paragraphs.cn: 在日记中或一 <u> 张 </u> 纸上，写下 <u> 标题 </u> " <u> 个人 </u> 优势"。想象一下，你是一名正在申请理想工作的 <u> 求职者 </u> 。你会着重突出你的技能和成就，来给 <u> 老板 </u> 留下深刻印象。现在列出你所喜欢的自己的所有 <u> 特质 </u> 。你 <u> 乐于助人 </u> 吗？ <u> 有创造力 </u> 吗？ <u> 慷慨大方 </u> 吗？是一个好的 <u> 倾听者 </u> 吗？认可这些特质就 <u> 点点头 </u> 吧。它们不必是能改变世界的，也不必像精通 <u> 书法 </u> 、会说 <u> 法语 </u> 或弹奏 <u> 爵士 </u> 吉他那样厉害，只要是你 <u> 个性 </u> 中能让你引以为 <u> 豪 </u> 的 <u> 方面 </u> 都可以。

paragraphs.en: At the top of a second page, put the heading "Acts of {kindness} ."On this one, list all the positive things you've done for others.It might be the time when you helped a {classmate} with his {homework} and offered him your {coat} on a cold {November} night, when you did the {ironing} without being asked, or when you {baked} {cookies} after the family had had a {tiring} day.It doesn't have to go so far as volunteering at a {church} or {praying} daily. {Whatever} it is, no matter how small it might seem, write it down.
paragraphs.cn: 在第二页的顶部，写下标题" <u> 善 </u> 举"。在这一页，列出你为他人做过的所有积极的事情。可能是你在 <u> 11月 </u> 的一个寒冷夜晚帮一位 <u> 同学 </u> 完成 <u> 家庭作业 </u> ，并把自己的 <u> 外套 </u> 借给他的时候；可能是在没有被要求的情况下主动 <u> 熨 </u> 了衣服；也可能是在家人度过 <u> 疲惫的 </u> 一天后，为他们 <u> 烤 </u> 了 <u> 饼干 </u> 。不一定非要做到像去 <u> 教堂 </u> 做义工或每天 <u> 祈祷 </u> 那种程度。 <u> 不管 </u> 是 <u> 什么 </u> 事情，不管它看起来多么微不足道，都要把它写下来。

paragraphs.en: You could ask a friend or family member to help {add} to your list.Whether they're a student in a {dormitory} or a professional working {downstairs} in a {studio} , they might like to have a go at doing the exercise, too.That way, you could {exchange} thoughts on what makes {each} of you {special} and the aspects of your personality that {shine} through.This process will make you both the teacher and the {pupil} , guiding yourself towards growth.In fact, don't wait until you've made a mistake to try this—it's a great way to boost {self-confidence} , which will act like {wings} that lift you into the sky.
paragraphs.cn: 你可以请朋友或家人帮你 <u> 补充 </u> 这个列表。无论他们是 <u> 宿舍 </u> 里的学生，还是在 <u> 楼下工作室 </u> 工作的专业人士，他们或许也乐意尝试这个练习。这样一来，你们就可以 <u> 交流 </u> 想法了，探讨 <u> 每个 </u> 人的 <u> 独特 </u> 之处，以及你们身上那些 <u> 闪光 </u> 点。这个过程会让你既是老师又是 <u> 学生 </u> ，引导自己不断成长。事实上，不要等到犯了错误才去尝试这样做——这是增强 <u> 自信 </u> 的一个好方法，而自信就像把你送上天空的 <u> 翅膀 </u> 。

paragraphs.en: It's something of a cliché ( (陈词滥调) ) that most people learn not from their {successes} but their mistakes.The thing is, it's true.But don't {punish} yourself by pressing your disappointment so hard on your {chest} .Whatever the mistake, remember it isn't a {fixed} aspect of your personality.Life can be like a game of {bowling} : sometimes you {knock} down all the pins, and other times you face a split.We're all changing and learning all the time, and mistakes are a positive way to develop and {grow} .
paragraphs.cn: 大多数人并非从 <u> 成功 </u> 中学习，而是从错误中学习，这种论调有些老套。事实的确如此。但是，不要把失望重重压在 <u> 胸膛 </u> 来 <u> 惩罚 </u> 自己。无论犯了什么错误，都要记住，它不是你个性中 <u> 固定不变的 </u> 一面。生活就像一场 <u> 保龄球 </u> 比赛：有时你能 <u> 击 </u> 倒所有木瓶，有时却会面临球瓶分散的困境。我们都在不断改变和学习，而错误正是促进我们发展和 <u> 成长 </u> 的一种积极方式。 5NoOncib/NjiX02BpMIzP+Fxyt/ox+WDCb+dhfH7KaYaJ4u5RsVmLondVmcHiLum9J1BQErGzJvzqa5GEIz4ZA==
